[CR CR4889 for 36.331] Reason for change: In Rel-9, the field of ue-ConfigRelease was added in inter-node message of HandoverPreparationInformation to indicate the RRC protocol release or version applicable for the current UE configuration. The motivation is to help target network to determine whether to apply the full configuration approach e.g. in case the release of current configuration is not supported by the target network. If this field is not present, the target assumes that the current UE configuration is based on the release 8 version of RRC protocol.
